scope: Theorem 3.14 (Structure of the residual tensor group) of the manuscript “Projective-space bases of Lagrangian fibrations” (preprints/Projective-Space-Bases-of-Lagrangian-Fibrations-September-23-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 041 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5fdf543649f1469a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 18. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For a maximal chart there is a decomposition Vfib = 1⊕s ⊕ r M i=1 Li, G = r Y i=1 Gi, Gi = SL(Li) or Sp(Li), (3.5) where each Gi acts by its standard representation on Li and trivially on all other summands. There are no repeated nontrivial irreducible summands. We place SL2 = Sp2 in the symplectic list. The integer s is the number of free rank-one direct summands of V .
